structs.name: bot_data_t
structs.size_evidence: NOT PROVEN. Replay proves members up to bot+32696 and nothing beyond. Lower bound 32696: the last direct bot access is the 4-byte flag at +32692 (Bot_ResetBotInfo@0x1413462e0, tested at entry and cleared). Likely 50104: SV_BotInit@0x141359d50 sets bot[2] (bot+16) = a1+34064 = bot+32696, and Bot_ResetBotInfo memsets that 17408-byte block (0x4400) through bot[2]; if the block is embedded, the struct reaches 50104. Upper bound 178184: SvClientMP has an unnamed _pad558 of 178184 bytes at client+0x558 = +1368 (bot), and sendAsActive begins at client+179552 (per A101; not re-verified). Best estimate 130888 = game-test 131056 - 168, because every Replay member after botInfo sits exactly 168 lower than game-test (botMatchData 29272, bIsScriptedAgent 32692, botDebugData 32696, the footer at 130880). Nothing in Replay reads or clears the footer at +130880 or copies the whole bot, so 130888 is not proven. Note that SvClientMP_ctor@0x141229890 writes byte 0xFF at bot+0 and SvClientMP_ResetClient clears the whole client (0x4E6A8), so neither bounds the bot.
members: Bot_ResetBotInfo@0x1413462e0: `*bot = entity` (8-byte store; entity = client+280, SV_BotInit passes `*(a1+280)`); SvClientMP_ctor@0x141229890 writes byte 0xFF at client+1368 (bot+0). Width is 8, not 4 (proposal)

structs.notes: Cross-agent finding for bot_info_t (A054/A055): the bot match data begins at raw bot+29272, so bot_info_t must end at or before botInfo+29264. IDA's bot_info_t is 29432 bytes, and its searchLookNodes array (botInfo+29252) runs across raw 29272, which is why IDA shows the difficulty store as searchLookNodes[6] and the personality store as [8]. The 168 bytes are somewhere in bot_info_t below 29264, and the members after botInfo are exactly gt - 168 in Replay, so the shift is inside bot_info_t. The renames below are not needed. Whether bot+16 (bot[2]) is botInfo+8 and points at the 17408-byte block is also for bot_info_t's owners.
